name: Epic Broadband
summary: Epic Infotech Pty Ltd trading as Epic Broadband; national NBN RSP launched ~late 2020; collapsed May 2021 when wholesale partner Vocus cut services over unpaid bills; company deregistered Dec 2021 (EPIC INFOTECH PTY LTD, ACN 635 207 224).

events.details: Collapsed; Vocus cut wholesale services over unpaid bills; deregistered Dec 2021.
